editionData.title: Spain pushes migrants back to Morocco as fallout deepens over mass border breach; Zelensky says Ukraine has ‘no interceptors’ as...
editionData.description: Global headlines: Spain pushes migrants back to Morocco as fallout deepens over mass border breach (The crisis in Ceuta, on the African coast, instantly became a touchstone in the global migrant debate as suspicions swirled that the viral incident was orchestrated); Zelensky says Ukraine has ‘no interceptors’ as ballistic missiles hit Kyiv (Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky had appealed for American air-defense missiles during a White House meeting on Tuesday); and U.S. general warns Pentagon he lacks sufficient forces to protect Israel (A shortage of Navy destroyers, used to defend against Iranian ballistic missile attacks, will force the head of U.S. European Command to prioritize the U.S. homeland instead, officials said). Markets leaned higher, with 6 of 7 tracked indexes up; Nikkei 225 up 4.03% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Go 1.27 Interactive Tour (An interactive tour of what’s new in Go 1.27: every notable language, runtime, and standard library change, with short runnable examples...); Running Kimi K3 on MI355X at Better Performance per Dollar Than B300 (The fastest open source LLMs for enterprise); and MkLinux and the pimped-out Apple Workgroup Server 9150 (oldvcr.blogspot.com: MkLinux and the pimped-out Apple Workgroup Server 9150). Product Hunt features Port22 (Claude Code, Codex & more on your phone), NudgeForMe (AI follow-up agent for missed email opportunities), and AgentMicro (Live Codex task status in your macOS menu bar).
editionData.author: Sony Mathew

headlines.title: Spain pushes migrants back to Morocco as fallout deepens over mass border breach
headlines.summary: The crisis in Ceuta, on the African coast, instantly became a touchstone in the global migrant debate as suspicions swirled that the viral incident was orchestrated.

headlines.title: Zelensky says Ukraine has ‘no interceptors’ as ballistic missiles hit Kyiv
headlines.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky had appealed for American air-defense missiles during a White House meeting on Tuesday.

headlines.summary: A shortage of Navy destroyers, used to defend against Iranian ballistic missile attacks, will force the head of U.S. European Command to prioritize the U.S. homeland instead, officials said.

headlines.title: Japan launches new intelligence bureau amid counter-espionage push
headlines.summary: Japan launched its new National Intelligence Bureau on July 31, marking the establishment of the country's first centralized national intelligence system since World War II. The launch represents another step in Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's efforts to strengthen Japan's intelligence capabilities and is expected to pave the way for additional counter-espionage legislation.
